text: Delivered regional technical assistance outputs including a consolidated risk modelling interface (DRMI), a proposed roadmap for the facility, and a concept for an ADB-sponsored Disaster Relief Bond. Convened two in-person engagement events, including one in Islamabad in 2023, to build consensus and capacity. Quantitative payout results are not yet applicable pending full operationalization.
